Details for each hop:

- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — `useCreateMemo()` (line 178) wraps a TanStack `useMutation` whose `mutationFn` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate })`, then invalidates memo lists and user stats on success.
- `web/src/connect.ts` — line 197 builds the Connect client: `export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`, using generated types from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` (line 21), annotated `post: "/api/v1/memos"` with `body: "memo"`. Generated Go stubs land in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`, wired to the service in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(...)` (line 70) authenticates the user, generates the UID, converts visibility, enforces the content-length limit, rebuilds the memo payload, then calls `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` at line 115.
- `store/memo.go` — `func (s *Store) CreateMemo(...)` (line 109) validates the UID against `base.UIDMatcher` and delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)`.
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — `func (d *DB) CreateMemo(...)` (line 16) assembles the field/placeholder lists and executes `INSERT INTO \`memo\` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING \`id\`, \`created_ts\`, \`updated_ts\`, \`row_status\`` (line 41). The sibling dialect drivers are `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`.
